🏢 MI HB 6427 — Data Centers Get a Shield in Michigan Zoning

Michigan is considering a change to how zoning decisions are made, specifically protecting data centers. This bill links zoning ordinances to several key state acts – including those related to electric transmission lines, renewable energy, and wireless communications – and establishes a process for challenging zoning decisions about property used for natural resource extraction. ...
